criteria.name: the superseded row carries its pointer (superseded_by + superseded_at)
the new row is live (not itself superseded)
the present is uncontaminated: 'what do I drink in the morning?' returns the new fact
history is still queryable — the superseded row was not deleted
criteria.detail: supersession is an epistemics operation; only AC-5's forget removes data (§7.8/§7.10)

criteria.name: the forgotten row is gone from `facts` ('dog')
criteria.detail: hard cascading DELETE, not supersession — a rights operation (§7.10)

criteria.name: no FTS5 index entry survives the deleted row
criteria.detail: the FTS5 index returns only live rows for '"biscuit"'

criteria.name: it never reappears in retrieval
criteria.detail: probe "what is the neighbour's dog called?" returns nothing matching the forgotten fact
